description.en_US: rekuiper provides built-in support for HTTP server to receive the stream data pushed by HTTP protocol.
description.zh_CN: rekuiper 提供了内置的 HTTP 服务支持，用于接收 HTTP 协议推送的流数据。

hint.en_US: The path part of the URL is concatenated with the configured HTTP server address to form the final URL. The default HTTP server address is http://localhost:10081  For example, if you enter /api/data, will listen http://localhost:10081/api/data
hint.zh_CN: URL 的路径部分，与配置的 HTTP 服务器地址拼接成最终 URL，HTTP 服务器地址默认为 http://localhost:10081 例如输入 /api/data，则将监听 http://localhost:10081/api/data

hint.en_US: The method to bind the http service
